import json

# Rules derived from the given data:
# 1. Proto-Chamic initial *d- becomes t- in Phan Rang Cham (dikiʔ>takiʔ, dilah>talàh, dalam-type words).
# 2. Unstressed pretonic vowels (i, ə) become a (dikiʔ>takiʔ, bəsey>pathey).
# 3. Final -a is kept; it takes a grave accent (à) only after an original voiced
#    consonant (r, l, b, d: bara>pirà, bala>pilà, paday>patày).
#    After a voiceless stop (mata>mɨta, rataːk>rataʔ) there is no accent.
# *dəpa: d>t, ə>a, p stays p (voiceless), final a without accent -> "tapa".

def derive(proto):
    out = []
    first = True
    voiced_prev = False
    for ch in proto:
        if first:
            out.append({"d": "t", "b": "p", "j": "c"}.get(ch, ch))
            first = False
            continue
        if ch == "ə":
            out.append("a")
        elif ch == "a" and voiced_prev:
            out.append("à")
        else:
            out.append(ch)
        voiced_prev = ch in "dbjrlg"
    return "".join(out)

answer = derive("dəpa")
print(json.dumps({
    "final_answer": answer,
    "evidence": {
        "proto": "*dəpa",
        "d>t": "dikiʔ>takiʔ, dilah>talàh",
        "ə>a": "bəsey>pathey",
        "no_accent_after_voiceless": "mata>mɨta, rataːk>rataʔ",
        "item": 6,
    },
}, ensure_ascii=False))
